lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: C++ Architecture, Namespaces & std::cout Streams

challenge.task: Print 'Hello C++' using std::cout.

lessons.content:
⚡
30-Second Mental Model

C++ zero-cost abstractions provide karta hai jisme high-level features machine code level par zero runtime overhead ke sath compile hote hain.

Zero-Cost
C++ Abstraction

Pay only for what you use at runtime.

Namespaces & Streams

Namespaces prevent identifier collisions across large codebases.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.2: Modern auto Type Deduction & Uniform Initialization {}

challenge.task: Declare auto x = 100; and print x with std::cout.

lessons.content:
⚡
30-Second Mental Model

Modern C++ mein `auto` compiler ko exact type deduce karne deta hai compile-time par without any runtime speed penalty.

auto Deduction
Compile-Time auto

Type safety without redundant type boilerplate.

Uniform Initialization

Braced init {} prevents accidental narrowing loss (e.g. float to int).

modules.title: Module 2: References, Memory Model & Pointers
modules.description: References (&), const references for zero-cost parameter passing, new/delete, and nullptr safety.

lessons.title: Lesson 2.1: C++ References (&) vs Pointers (Zero-Null Guarantee)

challenge.task: Pass int x = 10 by reference to a function adding 5. Print x.
challenge.hint: void add(int &a){a+=5;} int x=10; add(x); std::cout << x;

lessons.content:
⚡
30-Second Mental Model

References non-reseatable aliases hote hain jo null nahi ho sakte, pointers se zyada safe aur clean syntax provide karte hain.

References
C++ Reference (&)

Guaranteed non-null alias to existing object.

Reference Safety

Eliminates raw pointer null checks in modern C++ API design.

lessons.title: Lesson 2.2: const References (const &) for Zero-Cost Parameter Passing

challenge.task: Pass const std::string & to a function and print it.

lessons.content:
⚡
30-Second Mental Model

Large objects (strings, vectors, custom structs) ko hamesha 'const Type &' ke roop mein pass karein taki zero-copy speed mile aur original object protect rahe.

Zero-Copy
const Ref Idiom

Pass-by-reference speed + read-only safety.

Performance Idiom

The standard way to pass objects in C++.

lessons.title: Lesson 2.3: Dynamic Allocation with new/delete & Heap Mechanics

challenge.task: Allocate int on heap with new int(99), print value, and delete.
challenge.hint: int *p = new int(99); std::cout << *p; delete p;

lessons.content:
⚡
30-Second Mental Model

C++ mein `new` constructor call karta hai aur `delete` destructor invoke karke memory release karta hai.

Heap Operators
new & delete

Type-safe heap allocation invoking ctors/dtors.

new[] vs delete[]

Always pair new[] with delete[] to prevent heap corruption.

Deterministic Cleanup

Zero memory/file leaks guaranteed by C++ stack unwinding.

RAII Architecture

The foundation of smart pointers, mutex locks, and database handles.
